config.question: May I speak with [customer_name]?

textByLanguage.hi: क्या मेरी बात [customer_name] जी से हो रही है?

config.responseDirective: Silent step: reads the caller's answer to the greeting (the answer that started the workflow). No / wrong number / not me is 'no', anything else is 'yes'. Spoken only if the workflow ever starts without a caller answer. Spoken as fixed text: Hindi or Hinglish callers hear textByLanguage.hi, English callers hear textByLanguage.en.
